title: Fenton Figure Extractor
description: Multi-agent Fenton mining, step 4: extracts data from the image in a task package. mode=xy reads coordinates pointwise (degradation curves); mode=basic extracts characterization highlights (spectra and summary plots). All rules are inlined in system.md with no skills attached. The model is Gemini 3.8 Flash. The private tool pack_scan returns task.json, the package file list, and the archive panel list in one call. Read-only; the main agent writes results into the task package.
